items.name: Flask of the Titans
items.description: Increases maximum health by 1,200 for 2 hours. Persists through death.

items.name: Elixir of the Mongoose
items.description: Increases Agility by 25 and melee critical strike chance by 2% for 1 hour.

items.name: Elixir of Superior Defense
items.description: Increases armor by 450 for 1 hour. Stacks with Greater Stoneshield Potion in Classic.

items.name: Elixir of Fortitude
items.description: Increases maximum health by 120 for 1 hour.

items.name: Greater Stoneshield Potion
items.description: Increases armor by 2,000 for 2 minutes. Uses the shared combat-potion cooldown.

items.name: Smoked Desert Dumplings
items.description: Increases Strength by 20 for 15 minutes. Only one Well Fed food buff can be active.

items.name: Rumsey Rum Black Label
items.description: Increases Stamina by 15 for 15 minutes. Only one alcohol stamina buff can be active.

items.name: Mageblood Elixir
items.description: Restores 12 mana per 5 seconds for 1 hour.

items.name: Juju Power
items.description: Increases Strength by 30 for 30 minutes; conflicts with other Strength-family buffs such as Elixir of Giants.

items.name: Juju Might
items.description: Increases attack power by 40 for 10 minutes; conflicts with Winterfall Firewater.

items.name: Brilliant Wizard Oil
items.description: Adds 36 spell damage and 1% spell critical strike for 30 minutes. Only one temporary weapon enhancement can be active.

items.name: Gift of Arthas
items.description: Adds 10 Shadow Resistance and may afflict attackers, causing them to take 8 additional physical damage.

items.name: Flask of Supreme Power
items.description: Increases spell damage by 150 for 2 hours. Persists through death.

items.name: Greater Arcane Elixir
items.description: Increases spell damage by 35 for 1 hour.

items.name: Elixir of Greater Firepower
items.description: Increases Fire spell damage by 40 for 30 minutes.

items.name: Elixir of Frost Power
items.description: Increases Frost spell damage by 15 for 30 minutes.

items.name: Grilled Squid
items.description: Increases Agility by 10 for 10 minutes. Only one Well Fed food buff can be active.

items.name: Major Mana Potion
items.description: Restores mana and uses the shared combat-potion cooldown.

items.name: Demonic Rune
items.description: Converts health into mana; shares a cooldown with Dark Rune.

items.name: Mighty Rage Potion
items.description: Grants rage and Strength; uses the shared combat-potion cooldown.

items.name: Thistle Tea
items.description: Restores Energy and is usable by rogues.

items.name: Elemental Sharpening Stone
items.description: Adds melee critical strike chance to one weapon.

items.name: Goblin Sapper Charge
items.description: Explodes for 450 to 750 Fire damage to nearby enemies and the user.

items.name: Dragonbreath Chili
items.description: Occasionally belches flame at enemies for additional Fire damage.

items.name: Elixir of Shadow Power
items.description: Increases Shadow spell damage by 40 for 30 minutes.

items.name: Winterfall Firewater
items.description: Increases melee attack power by 35 for 20 minutes; conflicts with Juju Might.
